Want test‑time quality gains from a simple LLM architectural tweak? Try Recursive INference Scaling (RINS) — our #NeurIPS2025 work done at GDM.\
\
RINS trains by splitting a block into A+B and reusing A r times with shared weights. Params and pre‑training compute stay the same. https://t.co/yU9y0Sd2rV
